name: Ed. Turner
bio: Ed. Turner went to the O'Fallon creek round-up in May 1886 with Al. Uhlrich and George Myers. In November 1886 he married Kate Goodall and left on a wedding trip west to Oregon.
mentions: …bunch to recruit up started for the Hills, where the most of the band has been contracted. Cap., Fred and Ed. Turner made many friends here and if they will quit rustling we would be glad to see them again. We regret exceedingly, though, that Cap. should have wasted so much raw materia…
